manual_claim_checks.finding: The report is a consolidation of established formalizations, recorded obstructions and finite observations. It makes no conclusion resolving binary Goldbach, excludes neither complete programme, does not claim novelty for classical facts, and identifies the sole human author and model-provider/referee limitations.

The rational static Nullstellensatz lower bound is universal only in its stated calibration and assumptions. Equality is limited to 26 measured instances. The matching universal construction remains open. The polynomial-calculus restriction is formalized, while the external KnapsackLowerBound predicate remains an explicit hypothesis and its conditional consequence stays in Appendix B.

The 26 NS rows, 11 rational/finite-field PC rows, three finite-field-only PC rows and repeated-alpha grouping match the existing finite CSV/JSON tables. Grouping is described as finite consistency and is not promoted to a universal PC formula.

Common-zero claims name their constraint families, uniformity and direct-pinning controls. Coarse, sieve, dyadic, full, factor-horizon and proper Bertrand families are kept distinct. The proper family retains the m>=2 condition. C0/C1 circularity, finite literal models, the arbitrary rational factor-horizon statement and ordinary degree conventions are scoped to their recorded objects.

The accepted algebraic bundle is identified by its existing proof/Judge/source snapshots. Counts distinguish 25 modules, 233 theorem/lemma names, 204 printed theorem/lemma axiom headers and 356 inventory rows (233 theorem/lemma, 120 other named declarations, three constructors). Additional definition or constructor axiom prints are not counted as theorems. Missing separate axiom prints use NR and are not represented as empty axiom lists.

The analytic text preserves the actual additive Lambda projection, prime-power scope, canonical quantization, infinite-sum interchange requirements and nonzero individual-kernel integration-by-parts boundary. Absolute-square substitutes and envelope-to-sign implications are not asserted. A written weighted-Lambda tail remains SOURCE where the saved build failed.

Existing successful rows within globally failed audit batches are marked rowPASS, never whole-batch PASS. The Gamma local module in failed batch 26, other retained rows of failed batches 6, 7, 8, 9 and 11, and failed batch 36 tail/geometry outcomes are distinguished. Existing credit is not increased by manuscript preparation.

The numerical section was compared manually with the saved numerical_verdict.json: its single N=100000000 input, K=2^27, S=2^58, five modular residues, CRT product, reconstructed integer, 5761455 prime records and quantization-envelope values agree. The native Lean refinement, real-log quantization, Mellin truncation, D_N and WIN flags are false. The finite computation is outside the stated log N>=10^24 analytic onset and supplies no verification of the intervening interval.

Ten credited compiled obstruction groups retain their guarded intermediate scopes. Thirteen historical finite falsifiers retain Observed status and their exact saved inputs. The native connection counterexample is finite arithmetic. Finite-window absence of a counterexample is not promoted to a theorem.

Appendix B retains the quantitative premise 2541/4096<=twinConstant and the even/nonzero-input conditions. No discharge or unconditional singular-series margin is claimed. Material relying on unproved project axioms or physical analogies is excluded from established results; historical repository material requires existing Judge credit.

The eleven bibliography records and MSC metadata are supported by the saved bibliography verification artifact. This reviewer read that verification and did not perform a new literature-verification campaign.
